summary: Dynex Capital Inc. filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, regarding Amendment No. 9 to its existing distribution agreement, which updates the definition of 'Agent' and 'Agents' to include Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC as additional sales agents for at-the-market offerings of common stock under Rule 415(a)(4). The amendment reflects routine operational changes to the company's equity distribution program; no new securities issuance, pricing, or terms are disclosed. The filing does not constitute a significant event like an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return. It is a routine current report updating a material definitive agreement without indicating a special situation. There are no special-situation deal terms to analyze; the only action is an administrative update to the sales agent list.
